title: Read Abaqus model data with explicit units and atomic replacement
body:
Refs #98. `deck.read` imports bounded flat Abaqus model data into a fresh unsaved FieldCraft document using an explicit consistent input-unit preset. It reads labelled nodes/elements, sets and element surfaces, constant elasticity/density and representable sections. Unknown options and analysis history are reported with their original line numbers. Validation and cancellation finish before replacing the current model, results, path and undo state; desktop imports run as cancellable jobs with unsaved-work protection.

Material context now follows recognized material behaviors across unread options: `CONDUCTIVITY` before `ELASTIC`, `PLASTIC` before `DENSITY`, and FieldCraft's own `HYPERELASTIC` then `DENSITY` decks import the supported properties into the correct material. Unsupported behavior remains explicitly unread; a hyperelastic-only stiffness is absent after import and must be supplied before solving. Other model options and unrecognized keywords end the context. `GENERATE` names a zero increment at its data line, and the documentation explains that same-name `NSET`, `ELSET` and element `SURFACE` definitions combine into a FieldCraft set.

The three commits remain the pure reader, atomic command/catalogue and desktop workflow/documentation. Rebased onto upstream/develop `e8ee48d0`, retaining both orphan-mesh and deck imports in the background command list. No ROADMAP change or solver numerical change.

Current Linux CPU validation at `2d12cd7f5abaa4143282752eab82b71ad64e831c`:

- `cargo check -p fieldcraft-decks -p fieldcraft-engine -p fieldcraft-ui-egui` passed.
- Decks: 91 unit/integration tests passed. Engine: 383 passed, 15 heavy tests ignored; the sole initial failure was the rebased generated feature count. Regenerating through the compiled `engine::catalogue::features_page()` changed only 87 ready/35 coming soon to 88/34, and the exact previously failing test passed. The other engine tests were not repeated. This validates all 384 enabled engine tests against the final source tree.
- UI: all 197 unit tests passed using the already-built binary from the same three-package resolution. All 3 UI doctests passed; decks and engine have no doctests.
- All-targets clippy with `-D warnings` passed for decks, engine and UI. `cargo fmt --all`, manual simplification review and whitespace checks completed.
- `FIELDCRAFT_GPU=cpu` was set for runtime tests. No new native app or hardware-GPU run was performed.

The three fixups (reader/tests, generated feature page and documentation) are autosquashed into the corresponding original commits. Source tree `26f15da8172ff37f0835b222647867ac5908714d` is identical before and after autosquash.

New regressions cover material-context boundaries and separate materials, original unread lines, three actual FieldCraft-generated hyperelastic variants, combined node/element/surface sets, and zero increments. Before this fix, the new conductivity, writer-generated hyperelastic and zero-increment checks fail; with the fix they pass. Only original handwritten or FieldCraft-generated test data are used. Public [material data definition](https://docs.software.vt.edu/abaqusv2025/English/SIMACAEMATRefMap/simamat-c-materialdata.htm) supplies the scope rule; no commercial CAE software was run.

The original reusable `tools/abaqus-import/beam.json` recipe and `docs/abaqus-import.md` document the existing import-and-rebuild workflow. No new native or GPU validation was run for this revision. The historical media below was captured from source `c5203312e97857665facfcd985d38fd80eaddfd9`, on Windows with an RTX 4090 Vulkan viewport and CPU static solve; it does not show this review revision. The original/reconstructed 80 x 10 x 10 mm, 81-node, 32-hex8 beam had equal peak displacement 0.09613877492912645 mm at node 18 and peak von Mises 44.67 MPa. The 28-second movie is an edited held-frame recording with an appended caption band (repository Inter SemiBold under OFL 1.1). Artifact commit `5cfe546e7c2a978c7f9e1ff01d5faf44d9e80624` preserves originals; media remains attached outside feature history.

Limitations: flat model data only. Loads, constraints, steps, contact and coupling must be deliberately recreated. No raw passthrough, assembly/part/instance or INCLUDE support; input coordinate transforms are refused. Constant isotropic/engineering elasticity and density are supported; the documented other material behaviors remain unread. Review the unread report and material completeness before solving. The parser uses the existing wasm-compatible design, but this revision has no new browser-runtime or hardware-GPU validation.

reviews.author: jyviko
reviews.body:
Thank you, a deck reader is great to have, and the tests are thorough! One real problem:

- **The material context resets on any option the reader doesn't handle** (`read.rs`, the material-context reset in `parse`). FieldCraft's own writer output (`*HYPERELASTIC` then `*DENSITY`) is refused outright, and so is a deck with `*CONDUCTIVITY` before `*ELASTIC`. Please keep the material context across known material sub-options and report the ones we don't read as unread, and add our own written decks as a round-trip test.

Nits:
- An NSET, ELSET and SURFACE with the same name merge into one set holding nodes, elements and faces. That matches the writer, but please document it.
- `GENERATE` with increment 0 reports "label 0". A message naming the zero increment would be clearer.

Heads-up: #723 also touches `crates/ui-egui/src/files.rs`, so whichever lands second needs a quick rebase.

reviews.author: jyviko
reviews.body:
Reviewed. The hostile-input handling is thorough: the 64 MiB, line and continuation caps, set expansion bounded by work, depth and cycle checks, `GENERATE` counts checked before allocating, and cancellation throughout. I found no copied manual text or vendor decks, and units go only through `DisplaySystem::to_si`. Changes needed:

1. **The session's import caps are ignored** (`decks/src/abaqus/read.rs:27-28`, `engine/src/cmd/deck.rs:45`). `Session::limits` already has `max_import_nodes`, `max_import_elements` and `max_import_members`, which the orphan-mesh import passes through (`cmd/orphan.rs:35`), but `deck.read` uses hard-coded `MAX_RECORDS = 1M` and `MAX_MEMBERS = 2M`. The two importers disagree, and hostile-input tests can't make these refusals instant with small session caps. Please pass the session limits into `read_in`.
2. **Scope against the roadmap.** ROADMAP M9 and the old catalogue entry say "deck readers that keep unknown keywords". This PR drops unknown keywords (no passthrough), rewrites the description and marks the capability `ready` (`catalogue.rs:642`) without updating the ROADMAP. Please mark it partial and keep "keep unknown keywords" as the remaining part (the maintainer can decide otherwise), and update ROADMAP to match.
3. **Manual references:** `read.rs:5,11` and `docs/abaqus-import.md:112,141-148` link university mirrors of the vendor documentation (`abaqus-docs.mit.edu`, `docs.software.vt.edu`). Please cite the manual by title and version without the mirror links, as #724 does for EN standards.
4. `docs/abaqus-import.md` isn't in `docs/SUMMARY.md`. Also see #730: both PRs set the same features.md summary line, so regenerate on rebase.
